_note: The Day 4 (Insider Threat) fight. Same format as response_day3.json. New kinds: inside (a badge appears INSIDE the box, blinks for 'warn' seconds and bursts into 'count' bullets; with the counter it only appears from 'far_from' of the box width on; 'min_distance' keeps it away from the heart), ramp (a trickle whose gaps shrink from start_interval to end_interval; with the counter an alert at 'alert_at' of the duration stops the copying and ends the pattern), carry (carriers go for files: 'items' are positions as shares of the box; a carrier that reaches a file the heart is not guarding takes it out of the box, which costs 'loss_damage'; with the counter the carriers are slow and the file they want is marked).

comments.flawless: Joshua: Nothing got through. Recovery only needs a final check.
comments.won: Joshua: {threat} is stopped. These got through: {names}. Recovery will repair them.
comments.lost: Joshua: {threat} got through. Check your upgrades and your deck, then try again.

defenses.name: Least Access
defenses.works: The badges could only appear far away, so most of the box was safe.
defenses.harder: No Least Access: the badges appear anywhere, even next to you, and they burst in bigger rings.

defenses.name: Unusual Activity Alerts
defenses.works: The alert fired half way, and the copying stopped.
defenses.harder: No Unusual Activity Alerts: nothing notices the copying, so it keeps growing until it is dense.

defenses.name: Watch Outgoing Data
defenses.works: The carriers were slow and you saw which file each one wanted.
defenses.harder: No Watch Outgoing Data: the carriers are fast, and nothing shows which file they want.

defenses.name: Close Access on Exit
defenses.works: Closing the old access gave you a little more time.

patterns.name: Trusted access
patterns.teach: A badge appears inside the box. Move away before it bursts.
patterns.works_note: LEAST ACCESS: badges only far away

patterns.name: Slow copy
patterns.teach: A little at a time. Watch the COPIED bar.
patterns.say: Nobody will notice a little at a time.
patterns.works_note: WATCHING: an alert will stop the copying

patterns.name: Walk-out
patterns.teach: Stay near a file to guard it.
patterns.say: I will just take a copy home.

doom.name: NO LEAST ACCESS
doom.warn: WITHOUT THIS UPGRADE THE ATTACKS CANNOT BE STOPPED: they come as walls with no gap, Dodge does nothing, and every hit takes 30% of your HP.
doom.strike: The insider opens more of what is not theirs.
doom.lost: Joshua: Everyone could open everything, so one insider reached all the data. Give each person only the access the job needs.

_doom_note: doom: the upgrade this threat cannot be beaten without. When it is not equipped every pattern comes as a wall that fills the whole box (kind doomwall, no gap to dodge through), Dodge cards do nothing, and each hit takes 'percent' of the maximum HP (Block still takes its share). 'warn' is read at the start of the fight and 'lost' is Joshua's comment when the fight is lost.
